title: The Rook That Pays First
setup: Your rook on h5 stares at h7, your other rook waits on d1, and the black king cannot move a square.
hint: Ask which square the king must be standing on for your second rook to matter, then pay for it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxh7+}} costs a rook and {{Kxh7}} is forced. The h-file is now bare behind it, the pawn on f5 takes g6 away, and {{Rh1#}} swings across for mate. Two rooks beat one king as soon as the file in front of it is empty.
